newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOTEL OLUMPIA TO TAKE SYNDICATED LOAN.
newsitem.headline: HOTEL OLUMPIA TO TAKE SYNDICATED LOAN.

text.p: The Hotel Olumpia, in which a minority stake will be sold for vouchers in a public offer in summer, plans to take a syndicated loan worth 80-90 million kroons, it said on Tuesday.
"We will refinance our present outstanding loans and take on new funds to finance the reconstruction of the facade," Tarmo Sumberg, chairman, told Reuters.
The lead bank for the international syndicated loan is Hansapank .
The hotel plans to sign the loan agreement during the next two months, Sumberg added.
The terms will be more favourable than its present loans from local commercial banks, he said.
Hotel Olumpia, one of the largest hotels located at the centre of Tallinn, had net turnover of 43 million kroons in the first quarter, up 12.2 percent from the same period in 1996.
Its gross profit was 5.6 million kroons, up 25.2 percent.
The privatisation agency hopes to announce the public sale of 25.06 percent of its shares in June.
